questions.question: When Queen Esther begged King Xerxes to save her people, the Jews, what did she ask him to do?

answers.text: Write an order revoking Haman's letters
Give a royal guard to every Jew

questions.question: King Xerxes said a decree written in his name and sealed with his royal signet ring can be revoked. True or false?
In the letters Mordecai sent out for King Xerxes, what right were the Jews in every city given?

answers.text: To hide inside the king's palace

questions.question: When the fear of the Jews fell on many people of the land in King Xerxes' provinces, what did those people do?

answers.text: They rose up against the king
